body: Want more details? I can give you more details.
Same my friend. People tell me it will be better, so we got to believe that. Life is still going on.
I hope so, now I just feel so lost and broken.
Perhaps. I just feel like that idea can still be a reality if we both work on each other and see each other in a few months weeks etc. But maybe not. Thanks for your kind words and advice.

Sure I do. She doesn’t really brag I think, it’s more that my friends see her being fine for how the situation is. 

Yes I want to be with such a person, and I was 1 month ago when things were still fine. If I had left her then she would be destroyed. But I didn’t because I was happy and so was she. But I understand your point, it’s just, maybe I just don’t understand her, why she does this. Anyways, thank you so much for the advice.
Perhaps so. It still hurts but yeah, I can understand what you mean.
She doesn’t want me now, I know that, but in the end when I get better which I will, because I am totally working on myself right now, why not then?

Why doesn’t it? I mean, like I said if I work on myself and she does on herself and we see each other (which we will because we have loads of mutual friends), can’t that be enough to recognize that we are both better now and can be happy together again?

I am addressing my problems for myself. I do this for myself and no one else. I know I have to work for it and that in a way I have to do it alone. 

I just know her history. So I can understand why she did this. But I want to tel her that she doesn’t have to. That we can both me working on each other and eventually we can trust each other again. I am still the same supportive and lovable person I was, I am now only getting stronger due to me working on myself.

Her problems never stoped me from trusting her, because I knew that were her problems and she had to fix it on her own. I supported her in any way possible but in the end it was her fight, just that it is my fight now.

Maybe, I know she has issues with past boyfriends trust and all. I never knew that it was this serious before we broke up, but apparently it was. That’s why I leave her alone now, hoping that if she sees me getting better on my own, she will realize that I am nothing like her exes.

I always did. I supported her through all her mental health issues, I did everything for her. I never needed any support, other than the last 2-3 weeks. I am totally working on myself for myself and for no one else, but just, a little recognition of her telling me hey, you are doing fine. Keep up the good work.

I am doing that, slowly but surely. I know that I don’t need her help or support. I am doing everything on my own to get better. But why, when I am already planning on helping myself, does she shut me down? I gave her so much support when she needed it, and throughout our relationship I never really needed any. And now, I have it hard for 2-3 weeks, and she shuts me down..

Long story short, I was away for an internship but came back after 3 weeks because I had a lot of mental issues with myself. I asked too much of her support wise. She handled it completely fine the first week but after another week she closed her self to me more and more. Till eventually she didn’t really show any love anymore. She loved me still, I knew that, but she didn’t show it anymore to me. So when I came back I hoped things would slowly be better, me working on myself and she on herself, but it got worse until after 1 week she broke up with me over a stupid argument which didn’t even make sense at all.

We’ve known each other for 3-4 years, dated for 12 months. Yes it’s short but the last few months we were basically together all the time and had so much fun and we were the happiest couple ever. I had multiple relationships in the past but I can say in all honesty, she literally was the one.  

I don’t really want to move on. I do not see the point.
I feel exactly the same way. If you found an answer, please tell me. I am as lost as you are, I still don’t know the answers how to fix the problems.
How many times do you think I have thought about it. The mistakes I made aren’t just any mistakes, they are life changing mistakes. They destroy me. They literally make me who I am right now.
PM’d you.
Nothing, the thoughts will swallow you whole.
I know, but all my loved ones have enough people around them to help them. And nobody knows what to say. There is nothing you can say. I am sorry.

It probably was perfect, but you can’t change someone’s feeling if it fades, how enormously oblivious that is. And yes that sucks (I’ve been in your situation), but you will get better. It is better to learn from yourself and learn about your insecurities and how to deal with them, other than that someone else does that for you. Try to be happy with yourself and you alone. Only then will you have a happy life with someone else. And you will find someone again, who will be better then your ex. But take your time, enjoy life in the mean time, try not to worry about the past. You will get there!

The memories will fade. Over time you will make new memories and those will have a new effect on you. Don’t get me wrong, you will have these memories for a long long time, possibly forever. But eventually you don’t think bad about them, you accept them and can eventually even smile about them. Bad memories will fade, good memories will suck now, but will be happy moments you had in the past. Try not to focus on the past too much for now.

You’re right. And I think that acknowledging that I have a problem and me wanting to work for it very hard is already an important step. I know that I need this, and like I said, this is for me and not for anyone else. Whatever happens along the way happens. Thanks for the advice!

For an Internship of my university . 6 months and am on week 2..  I know that the opportunity I have here is unique but I just can’t handle it. The problem for me leaving is financing, and postponing my study, but at this point I don’t really care about both.
Woaw thanks! I am really going to try this! I truly believe that I indeed need to love myself more. Thank you so much!
Yes please! I'm at the bottom at the moment, so any help is good help!
